summary: A new server: nothing set up

services.name: TMDB
services.summary: Not set up: titles come from file names and your folders.
services.with: Titles are matched on TMDB: posters, backdrops, plots, cast, genres, ratings and episode names.
services.without: Titles and years come from file and folder names (and NFO files or the files' own tags); artwork from images in your folders (poster.jpg, fanart.jpg…), cover art inside the files, or a frame of the video.

services.name: OpenSubtitles
services.summary: Not set up: subtitle search is hidden.
services.with: Find Subtitles searches OpenSubtitles.com; a subtitle fetched once plays on every device. Without an account: 5 downloads a day; with a free account 20; VIP accounts more.
services.without: Find Subtitles is hidden. Subtitles inside your files and next to them still play.

services.name: AI matching
services.summary: Not set up: unclear file names go to Fix Match.
services.with: A language model reads unclear or transliterated file names and picks among TMDB's candidates; every answer is checked (year, runtime, title).
services.without: Titles are matched by name, year and runtime; the ones that stay unclear wait in Fix Match with their likely candidates for you to pick.

services.attribution: Information courtesy of IMDb (https://www.imdb.com). Used with permission. Rotten Tomatoes and Metacritic scores through OMDb (omdbapi.com), CC BY-NC 4.0.
services.name: Ratings
services.summary: IMDb ratings from IMDb's dataset. Add a free OMDb key for Rotten Tomatoes and Metacritic.
services.with: Title pages show IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes and Metacritic beside TMDB. A free OMDb key (omdbapi.com) allows 1,000 look-ups a day; the server uses at most 500, a few seconds apart, and looks each title up again every two weeks.
services.without: Title pages show IMDb's rating (from IMDb's dataset, read about once a week) and TMDB's.

services.name: Remote access
services.with: Put the server's computer and your devices on Tailscale (free): the apps reach the server from anywhere, with nothing opened to the internet.
services.without: The apps reach the server on your home network only; downloads still play anywhere.
